title: Concept Drift and Long-Tailed Distribution in Fine-Grained Visual Categorization: Benchmark and Method

bias_targets.methodology: Grouping dataset subclasses into many-shot, medium-shot, and few-shot categories, and evaluating the top-1 classification accuracy of various vision models (e.g., ResNet, ViT, CLIP) to measure performance degradation on rare, underrepresented classes.

Using Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD) to quantify feature distribution shifts over time, and comparing model classification performance when trained on single-season data versus data that includes temporal appearance changes.
